rrweb-record.min.js is @rrweb/record 2.2.0 (https://github.com/rrweb-io/rrweb), MIT licence, vendored unmodified
(dist/record.umd.min.cjs) so the extension ships no remote code. It records the DOM of a tab the agent has chosen to
share with CoreX support (CoreX Desk, spec .ai/specs/corex-desk.md section 13). To refresh: npm install @rrweb/record,
copy dist/record.umd.min.cjs over this file, bump the version above.
